summary: Selectis Health, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Merger Agreement with Black Pearl Equities II, LLC and its acquisition sub, whereby Purchaser will make a cash tender offer for all outstanding shares at $5.75/share. The offer is subject to a minimum tender condition of 70% of shares, appraisal rights cap of 15%, and certain company demonstrations including $6.8M cash and clear title. No financing condition exists. Post-offer, a merger will take the company private. The board's recommendation is not stated; no advisor named. Watch stock tender rate and regulatory approvals in Oklahoma.
